summary: Reserve NVFP4 routed workspace using packed activation width
compatibility: Shared-expert scratch reservations retain logical output width when routed NVFP4 activations pack two values per byte. Backends that defer activation quantization retain their unpacked workspace geometry.
details: FlashInfer CUTLASS, CuTeDSL and TRTLLM modular NVFP4 experts receive the same packed K used after input preparation.
Routed and shared scratch remain disjoint views from one simultaneous arena reservation.
